name: dev-orchestrator
description: Multi-phase development workflow orchestrator with persistent cross-session state. Supervised modes (speed, efficiency with cluster-based delegation) and one-shot autonomous mode. Batch or interactive guidance collection. Deferred or per-phase acceptance review with contract-affecting deviation detection via roadmap Affects annotations. Token-efficiency design with prompt-cache preservation, bounded handoffs, and cost-metric observability (agent-spawn proxies plus a one-shot spawn ceiling).
